Primer3 / primer3-py integration notice
======================================

This application can call primer3-py for local oligonucleotide
thermodynamic analysis. Primer3 and primer3-py are free software distributed
under the GNU General Public License version 2 (or, for Primer3 where stated,
any later version).

Primer3 project and corresponding source:
https://github.com/primer3-org/primer3

primer3-py project and corresponding source:
https://github.com/libnano/primer3-py

The Primer3 and primer3-py projects are not authored by the cadnano_xinxin
maintainers. Their copyright notices and license terms remain applicable.
